meta.also: user-47/noq-social docs/brand.md (social palette, layouts, motion, voice)

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: THE brand colour (--action-primary). Primary buttons, the logo chevrons, CTA pills, highlights. Always with `on-lime` text. As text only on `surface` in Dark (14.7:1); never as text in Light (1.2:1).

tokens.name: lime-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of a lime fill (--action-primary-hover); also the second logo chevron.

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `lime` or `lime-hover` fill (14.7:1). Never white on lime.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. Dark: dashboard, social, auth panels (--surface-background-dark). Light: marketing site and app background (--surface-background-light).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, modals on `surface` (--surface-dark-elevated / --neutral-white).

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row and card hover (--surface-dark-hover / --surface-interactive).

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: The active pill of TabToggle and other inverted chips; text on it is `ink-inverse`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers, input and card borders (--border-inverse-medium / --borders-dividers). Decorative: it does not need 3:1.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that mark a control's edge. Dark is --border-inverse-strong; the Light value is an intentional addition (the code only has #e5e7eb).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-hover` in both themes (16:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata. Dark: --text-on-dark-subtle (8.3:1 on `surface`). Light: --text-secondary-light, 4.8:1 on `surface-raised` but 4.3:1 on `surface` (#f0f2f5): kept exact from the code; use `ink-muted-strong` for small text on `surface`.

tokens.name: ink-muted-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary text that must pass on every ground (--text-on-dark-strong / --text-secondary-strong, 5.3:1 on #f0f2f5).

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and placeholders (--text-disabled). Below 4.5:1 by design; never for information.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `surface-inverse`.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links (--text-link). 5.1:1 on Dark `surface`; 3.7:1 on white, so in Light keep links underlined and 16px+.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success, Live, Active dot (--success). As text only on Dark grounds (7.4:1); in Light use it as a dot or fill, with a word beside it.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of a success banner (--success-subtle).

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: Border of a success banner (--success-border).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention, nothing failed (--warning). As a fill with `on-lime` text it is the low-stock pill everywhere: "Only 4 left" for guests, "Low · 3" for vendors (8.7:1). As text only on Dark grounds.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of a warning banner (--warning-subtle).

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Border of a warning banner (--warning-border).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Errors, invalid fields, destructive actions (--error). 5.0:1 on Dark `surface`; 3.8:1 on white: kept exact from the code (FieldError is 12px bold), flagged.

tokens.name: error-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of an error banner (--error-subtle).

tokens.name: error-border
tokens.usage: Border of an error banner (--error-border).

tokens.name: sold-out
tokens.usage: "Sold out" pill text, always on `sold-out-bg` (6.7:1). The vendor dashboard's StockBadge still uses white on `error` (3.8:1); see the Alignment register.

tokens.name: sold-out-bg
tokens.usage: "Sold out" pill background (vendor badge, social).

tokens.name: status-new
tokens.usage: Order status pill: New Order. Fill with `on-lime` text; always with the word.

tokens.name: status-started
tokens.usage: Order status pill: Started. Fill with `on-lime` text.

tokens.name: status-awaiting
tokens.usage: Order status pill: Awaiting Pickup. Fill with `on-lime` text.

tokens.name: status-picked
tokens.usage: Order status pill: Picked Up. Fill with `on-lime` text.

tokens.name: new-order-flash
tokens.usage: The ring and border of the new-order highlight animation on the vendor orders list (--status-order-highlight).

tokens.name: social-ink
tokens.usage: Social stills and Reels: ground. Same as Dark `surface`.

tokens.name: social-panel
tokens.usage: Social: cards and panels. The social neutrals lean slightly olive toward lime, unlike the product's pure greys.

tokens.name: social-line
tokens.usage: Social: card borders and dividers.

tokens.name: social-text
tokens.usage: Social: headline and body text on `social-ink` and `social-panel`.

tokens.name: social-muted
tokens.usage: Social: secondary text, footers, struck-through "myths" (8.2:1 on `social-ink`).

tokens.name: social-glow
tokens.usage: Social: the soft lime radial glow behind still and Reel content. Max one per frame.

tokens.name: winter-ice
tokens.usage: Seasonal accent (winter batches): temperature chips and cards. Off-season, don't use.

tokens.name: legacy-indigo
tokens.usage: Legacy secondary button (--action-secondary, `btn-blue`). Don't use in new work.

tokens.name: legacy-slate
tokens.usage: Legacy brand surface (--surface-brand, `dark-blue`). Don't use in new work.

tokens.name: overlay-modal
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals (--overlay-modal).

tokens.name: overlay-image
tokens.usage: Scrim over a product photo with white "Sold out" or "Unavailable" text in the guest app (bg-black/50). Over a white photo this gives only 4.0:1, so the label must stay large and bold (20px+, 700); the code uses 600, flagged in the Alignment register.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset. Lime on Dark grounds (14.7:1), ink on Light (16.7:1). Intentional addition: the code uses ring-primary, which is 1.2:1 on light grounds.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Space Grotesk 500/700 from Google Fonts. Web sizes are fluid clamps in the code; the value here is the largest step, the minimum is in each usage note.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card and section titles, empty-state titles. clamp(24px, 2vw, 36px).

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Small headings, list group titles. clamp(18px, 1.3vw, 22px).

styles.name: social-headline
styles.sample: Never sell the plate you don’t have.

groups.name: Body
groups.note: Inter 400/500/600 (700 for buttons) from Google Fonts.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Guests scan, order and pay from their phones.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Vendors receive every order in one place.
styles.usage: Default running text and form labels.

styles.name: label-caps
styles.usage: Uppercase audience tags and eyebrows (social: 22px at 1080 wide, tracking 2px).

spacing.note: Tailwind's default 4px scale, as the product uses it. Social frames use 64px margins.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in tight chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Badge gaps, dot to label, TabToggle track padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button and input vertical padding (py-3).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding, field spacing, mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (px-6), card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards and sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Social still and Reel margins; large section spacing.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding (py-24); marketing section rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs (rounded-noq-sm).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, modals (rounded-noq-md).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels, empty states (rounded-noq-lg).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Social: photo frames and myth/fact cards at 1080 wide.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: tabs, badges, status pills, CTA pills, switches (rounded-noq-full).

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Light inputs and cards (--shadow-sm). The product is mostly flat: borders before shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-device
tokens.usage: Social only: phone and Duo mockups floating over `social-ink`.
